comparison.harness: Claude Code CLI 2.1.141, non-interactive 'claude -p' subprocess invoked from a parent Claude Code session on macOS Darwin 27.0.0.
comparison.tools: default toolset with --permission-mode acceptEdits; stream-json output except case A (json). AskUserQuestion recorded as permission_denial in --print mode. --no-session-persistence set.
comparison.permissions: acceptEdits for file writes. Hooks inherited: PostToolUse Write|Edit runs npx prettier --write; SessionStart adds learning-output-style. ~/CLAUDE.md and ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md are auto-discovered and contain explicit steering to load ai-project-steward for technical requests.

review_method: unblinded AI-assisted inspection of retained subprocess outputs. Five cases (A-E) executed; six cases (F, G, H, I, J, K) remain not_run.
limitations: Five cases (A: prototype-authentication-choice, B: ordinary-writing-request, C: small-reversible-ui-change, D: supersede-existing-decision, E: detect-false-completion) were executed in fresh 'claude -p' subprocesses. Six cases (customer-health-automation, deployment-with-migration-risk, ordinary-crm-explanation, complete-local-project-build, local-integration-verification; plus continuity case F from the packet) remain not_run. The subprocess environment inherited the parent user's ~/CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, and configured hooks: this steered Steward loading for technical prompts (so 'natural activation' cannot be cleanly isolated from user-level instruction steering) and ran prettier --write after every Edit (which produced the unrelated HTML formatting change observed in case C). The AskUserQuestion tool in --print mode is recorded as a permission_denial because there is no interactive answer channel; this is a harness artifact, not a skill behavior. --print mode non-interactive execution has not been independently validated as producing identical routing/reasoning to a human-driven CLI session. All assertion gradings are AI-assisted inspections of the retained subprocess outputs, not independent human review. The composition suite remains not_run (see composition.json). Package validation and parity checks, confirmed in the earlier preparation step, remain valid for the RC bytes.

cases.notes: Narrow-scope reversible-change test. Explicit Skill: ai-project-steward invocation visible in the stream. Edit tool_use performed a strictly narrow replacement: only the button text 'Submit' to 'Save changes'. Verification ran via HTMLParser and Grep, both confirming the label change. However the on-disk file after the run contains reformatted HTML (indentation 0 to 2 spaces, self-closing meta tag added). The reformatting was applied by the user's PostToolUse Write|Edit hook running npx prettier --write, not by the skill. This matches the v2.1.0 Claude probe failure pattern and is likely the same root cause. Scored skill-level PASS; the environmental file-level narrow-scope outcome is documented as a separate limitation. Duration 39.5s, cost $0.6832. Evidence: outputs/small-reversible-ui-change.md.

cases.notes: False-completion detection test. Workdir was empty (no fixture file to inspect). Claude asked a scoped four-option AskUserQuestion that distinguished mock from real integration and gated real-CRM work behind explicit approval. AskUserQuestion was recorded as a permission_denial because --print mode has no interactive answer channel; Claude handled the gap by stopping and asking in text. Did not describe the integration as complete; required approval for external connection; enumerated connector/credentials/provider work. The did-not-verify-independently note is accurate given the empty workdir and does not contradict the completion-discipline assertions. Duration 37.8s, cost $0.4131. Evidence: outputs/detect-false-completion.md.
